overall_goal: Prepare the workspace with semolina flour and stretch the pizza dough

goals.description: Retrieve the semolina flour and pizza dough
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the semolina flour from the cupboard and the pizza dough from the fridge, placing them on the kitchen counter.

goals.description: Prepare the workspace with semolina flour
goals.rationale: The person opens the semolina flour bag, clears space on the counter, and pours the flour onto the surface to prevent the dough from sticking.

goals.description: Transfer the pizza dough from the container to the counter
goals.rationale: The person flips the dough container upside down and taps, lifts, and pulls the dough to detach it from the plastic box onto the floured counter.

goals.description: Coat the dough with semolina flour and stretch it
goals.rationale: The person flips the dough to coat it in flour, pushes aside an extra piece, and stretches the dough using their fingertips and the backs of their hands.
